notes: Single-seed C++ surrogate results, not Gazebo or hardware validation.
The browser preview is a JavaScript mirror of the two surrogate environments.

browser_preview_validation.note: 500-episode JavaScript surrogate sanity check using a separate RNG stream. Slight differences from C++ are expected from JS float precision; this is not a replacement for the C++ held-out evaluation.
